units: Ber. 20ᵃ (a proverb cited, when a person was fined for attacking a Samaritan woman named מתון) היינו דאמרי אינשי מ׳ מ׳ ארבע וכ׳ Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) that is what people say, mathun, mathun (to be slow) is worth four hundred Zuz.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:10">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:24">VIII</cite>), 24, sq.; a. e.—Pl. <he>מְתוּנִים</he>, <he>מְתוּנִין</he>; f. <he>מְתוּנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:1">Ab. I, 1</cite> <he>הוו מ׳ בדין</he> be careful in judgment.

<cite ref="Tosefta Makhshirin 1:8">Tosef. Makhsh. I, 8</cite> <he>טיפין מ׳</he> (R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 2:4">Makhsh. II, 4</cite> <he>חתוכות</he>) slow (interrupted) drops, opp. <he>טפה אחר טפה</he>; a. e. [Chald. <cite ref="M03025"><he>מָתוּן</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="M03057"><he>מַתְיָן</he></cite>.]
